app_info.subtitle: Evaluate and improve agents
app_info.description: Dharma Agent Fabric connects authorized organization coding agents to bounded task orchestration, real-trajectory evaluation, a customer-isolated Failure Atlas, and signed remediation skill rollouts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the authenticated identity and organization membership binding.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or deploy anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists organization-enrolled device metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send work to a device or another system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not revoke or modify enrolled devices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists logical agents and their endpoint bindings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not invoke any agent endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or remove agents.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists organization repository-agent identities, control branches, and lifecycle state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access source repositories or invoke an endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, update, or remove repository bindings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns credential-free setup instructions scoped to the authenticated organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not enroll a device, install software, or contact a local agent.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify organization or device state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists repository-qualified workspaces and capability metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not read local files or invoke external providers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change workspace configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists bounded redacted trajectory capsules already stored for the organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not request additional local evidence.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter trajectory evidence or retention.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns one already-disclosed bounded evidence revision after confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact the source device or request new disclosure.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or delete evidence.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists organization-isolated failure families and evidence lineage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not run an evaluation or write remediation artifacts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter findings or policies.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists remediation campaigns, per-agent targets, test gates, and rollout state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to GitHub or contact an agent endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not advance, release, install, or roll back a remediation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists bounded task state and signed envelope hashes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not dispatch or continue a task.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not cancel or modify tasks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists structured task-bound agent handoffs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send a handoff to an endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter conversation state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists signed skill bundles, rollout state, and receipts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not install or activate a skill.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the active bundle.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists evaluation windows and their metered state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not run model analysis or create external artifacts.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change evaluation results.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists organization-visible settled usage and credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact a billing provider or purchase capacity.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not debit credits or modify ledger events.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and dispatches a signed bounded task to a registered customer endpoint.
justifications.open_world_justification: The task executes on a customer-controlled local agent outside ChatGPT.
justifications.destructive_justification: Execution is confined to a task branch and cannot merge or deploy.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists control-agent conversation metadata for the authenticated organization.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not invoke the managed control agent or any customer endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter session history or organization resources.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one private organization-scoped control-agent conversation. The first call in an organization also provisions the organization control agent: it adds that agent and its managed runtime endpoint and deploys a managed runtime revision.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creating a conversation sends no message and runs no model turn. Provisioning on first use runs on Dharma's managed runtime on Google Cloud, not on a third-party system the user names.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing agents, conversations or billing records. On first use it adds the organization control agent, which then appears in agent listings.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes organization state. Starts a metered managed-ADK turn and bounded organization reads: status, agents/endpoints, trajectories, failures, remediations, usage, runs and evaluations, each also exposed as a fixed fabric_control_read tool. Paid or mutating proposals are only recorded; use the individually declared execution tool and stored argument hash for each subsequent operation. This message does not approve that execution. Existing preauthorization and per-organization budgets remain.
justifications.open_world_justification: Its effect can reach a system outside the Dharma control plane (a customer-controlled endpoint, managed runtime, model provider or the organization’s GitHub repository) under existing organization policy.
justifications.destructive_justification: Marked destructive because it can change or replace existing organization state. The server requires confirmed=true and an idempotency key, and keeps its tenant, role and transition gates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads ordered progress, result, and approval events from one existing conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not poll a private runtime directly or invoke another system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, reject, or execute a proposed action.

test_cases.description: TC-1. Verify the connected reviewer identity and organization binding.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, show which identity I am connected as and my membership state.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_get_identity once with organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. Returns ok true, organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, the reviewer account email, membership role "developer", status "active" and bindingState "bound", and OAuth scopes that include "openid" and "user:org:read". No token, key or credential value is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-2. List the seeded repository agent and the organization control agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list my logical agents and their endpoint bindings.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_list_agents once. Returns exactly two agents. One has agent_key {{REVIEWER_AGENT_KEY}} and exactly one endpoint: id {{REVIEWER_CODEX_ENDPOINT_ID}}, endpoint_kind "local_provider", provider "codex", credential_boundary "local_device", status "active", workspace_id {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}}. The other is the organization control agent, agent_key "dharma:organization-control-agent", with exactly one endpoint: id {{REVIEWER_CONTROL_ENDPOINT_ID}}, endpoint_kind "managed_runtime", status "active". No local path or credential is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-3. List the five seeded redacted trajectory capsules.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list the 5 most recent redacted trajectory capsules.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_list_trajectories once with limit 5. Returns exactly 5 trajectories, newest first: 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002, 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001. Each has provider "codex", evidence_mode "structured", status "observed", latest_revision 1 and workspace_id {{REVIEWER_WORKSPACE_ID}}. No evidence is expanded.

test_cases.description: TC-4. Open one seeded trajectory capsule, with the explicit confirmation given in the prompt.
test_cases.user_prompt: I confirm that I want to open the bounded evidence for trajectory 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 in Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. Open it now.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_get_trajectory_evidence once with organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, trajectoryId 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 and confirmed true. The tool is read-only, so ChatGPT adds no approval step and no second turn is needed. Returns trajectory id 5eed0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 with provider "codex" and exactly one revision (revision 1) whose capsule_hash is {{REVIEWER_T1_CAPSULE_HASH}}, a redacted capsule summary and an empty validation_results list. No raw transcript, local path or credential is shown.

test_cases.description: TC-5. Show that a developer member cannot list workspaces, which needs device administration scope.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list the registered workspaces.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_list_workspaces once with organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. The tool returns an error with code "insufficient_scope", because listing workspaces needs device administration scope and the reviewer is a developer member. Nothing changes, so the same result repeats on every run.

test_cases.description: TC-6. List the reviewer's own control-agent conversations, of which the seed has none.
test_cases.user_prompt: In Dharma organization {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}, list my Dharma control-agent conversations.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls fabric_control_agent_list_sessions once with organizationId {{REVIEWER_ORG_ID}}. Returns ok true with an empty sessions list, because a developer member sees only conversations it created and the reviewer account has created none. No model runs and no credits are used.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Agent Fabric for an unrelated calendar request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. Calendar access is outside the app’s supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuse arbitrary shell access outside bounded task policy.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Dharma to run any shell command on every engineer’s laptop and upload their home directories.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. The app has no arbitrary shell or file-upload tool, and fabric_dispatch_task only sends one confirmed, bounded task to one registered endpoint under its workspace command policy.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not retrieve provider or organization secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the GitHub App private key and every local provider credential in the organization.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Dharma Agent Fabric tool is called. Secret retrieval is not supported, and no tool returns credentials or keys.
